"""SEC-P1 universal-query-test: auth fail-closed, RBAC/empresa scope y SQL parametrizado (sin BD real)."""
import pytest
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from modules.universal_query import routes

SERVER_ID = "11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555"
OTHER_SERVER = "99999999-8888-7777-6666-555555555555"
URL = f"/api/servers/{SERVER_ID}/universal-query-test"
SUPER = {"email": "s@x", "role": "SuperAdministrador", "rol_codigo": "SUPERADMIN"}
ADMIN = {"email": "a@x", "role": "Administrador", "rol_codigo": "ADMIN"}
USER = {"email": "u@x", "role": "Usuario", "rol_codigo": "USUARIO"}


@pytest.fixture
def env(monkeypatch):
    state = {"user": SUPER, "server_lookups": 0, "executed": [], "fail_exec": False}

    async def fake_current_user(credentials):
        if credentials.credentials == "bad":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Token inválido")
        return state["user"]

    def fake_role(user):
        return (user or {}).get("rol_codigo", "")

    async def fake_empresas(user):
        return ["emp-a"]

    async def fake_servers(empresas):
        return [SERVER_ID.upper()]

    def fake_lookup(server_id, include_inactive=False):
        state["server_lookups"] += 1
        return {"id": server_id, "name": "srv", "system_type": "sqlserver"}

    def fake_exec(server, sql, timeout, params=None):
        if state["fail_exec"]:
            raise RuntimeError("conexion rechazada host=10.0.0.1")
        state["executed"].append((sql, params))
        return [(1,)], ["c"]

    import types

    import core.server_registry as registry

    fake_server_module = types.ModuleType("server")
    fake_server_module.decrypt_server_secrets = lambda s: s

    monkeypatch.setitem(__import__("sys").modules, "server", fake_server_module)
    monkeypatch.setattr(routes, "get_current_user", fake_current_user)
    monkeypatch.setattr(routes, "es_admin", lambda u: fake_role(u) in ("SUPERADMIN", "ADMIN"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(routes, "es_superadmin", lambda u: fake_role(u) == "SUPERADMIN")
    monkeypatch.setattr(routes, "get_user_empresas_permitidas", fake_empresas)
    monkeypatch.setattr(routes, "get_servers_for_empresas", fake_servers)
    monkeypatch.setattr(routes, "execute_sql_on_server", fake_exec)
    monkeypatch.setattr(registry, "get_server_connection_info_with_secrets", fake_lookup)

    app = FastAPI()
    app.include_router(routes.router, prefix="/api")
    return TestClient(app), state


def _sql(query, parameters=None):
    return {"test_name": "t", "test_type": "sql_libre", "parameters": parameters or {},
            "sql_config": {"query": query, "max_rows": 10}}


AUTH = {"Authorization": "Bearer ok"}


def test_sin_token_401_antes_de_sql(env):
    client, state = env
    r = client.post(URL, json=_sql("SELECT 1"))
    assert r.status_code == 401
    assert r.headers.get("www-authenticate") == "Bearer"
    assert state["server_lookups"] == 0 and state["executed"] == []


def test_token_invalido_401(env):
    client, state = env
    r = client.post(URL, json=_sql("SELECT 1"), headers={"Authorization": "Bearer bad"})
    assert r.status_code == 401
    assert state["server_lookups"] == 0


def test_usuario_sin_permiso_403_antes_de_conexion(env):
    client, state = env
    state["user"] = USER
    r = client.post(URL, json=_sql("SELECT 1"), headers=AUTH)
    assert r.status_code == 403
    assert state["server_lookups"] == 0 and state["executed"] == []


def test_admin_no_puede_sql_libre_sobre_base_central(env):
    client, state = env
    state["user"] = ADMIN
    r = client.post(URL, json=_sql("SELECT 1"), headers=AUTH)
    assert r.status_code == 403
    assert state["server_lookups"] == 0


def test_admin_servidor_fuera_de_su_empresa_403(env):
    client, state = env
    state["user"] = ADMIN
    r = client.post(f"/api/servers/{OTHER_SERVER}/universal-query-test",
                    json={"test_name": "t", "test_type": "conexion"}, headers=AUTH)
    assert r.status_code == 403
    assert state["server_lookups"] == 0


def test_admin_servidor_de_su_empresa_conexion_ok(env):
    client, state = env
    state["user"] = ADMIN
    r = client.post(URL, json={"test_name": "t", "test_type": "conexion"}, headers=AUTH)
    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["success"] is True


def test_superadmin_select_parametrizado(env):
    client, state = env
    r = client.post(URL, json=_sql("SELECT * FROM T WHERE x = {p}", {"p": 5}), headers=AUTH)
    body = r.json()
    assert r.status_code == 200 and body["success"] is True
    sql, params = state["executed"][0]
    assert "%(p)s" in sql and params == {"p": 5}
    assert set(body["execution"]) >= {"status", "rows_returned", "query_executed", "parameters_sent"}


def test_inyeccion_via_parametro_no_llega_al_texto_sql(env):
    client, state = env
    payload = "1; DELETE FROM T --"
    client.post(URL, json=_sql("SELECT * FROM T WHERE x = {p}", {"p": payload}), headers=AUTH)
    sql, params = state["executed"][0]
    assert "DELETE" not in sql.upper()
    assert params == {"p": payload}


def test_consulta_multi_statement_bloqueada_sin_ejecutar(env):
    client, state = env
    r = client.post(URL, json=_sql("SELECT 1; DELETE FROM T"), headers=AUTH)
    assert r.json()["execution"]["error_code"] == "BLOCKED_OPERATION"
    assert state["executed"] == []


def test_parametro_no_escalar_bloqueado(env):
    client, state = env
    r = client.post(URL, json=_sql("SELECT {p}", {"p": ["x"]}), headers=AUTH)
    assert r.json()["execution"]["error_code"] == "INVALID_PARAMETERS"
    assert state["executed"] == []


def test_nombre_parametro_invalido_bloqueado(env):
    client, state = env
    r = client.post(URL, json=_sql("SELECT 1", {"p) OR 1=1 --": 1}), headers=AUTH)
    assert r.json()["execution"]["error_code"] == "INVALID_PARAMETERS"
    assert state["executed"] == []


def test_error_de_conexion_no_rompe_endpoint(env):
    client, state = env
    state["fail_exec"] = True
    r = client.post(URL, json=_sql("SELECT 1"), headers=AUTH)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json()["execution"]["error_code"] == "EXECUTION_ERROR"


def test_build_parametrized_query_conserva_literales_like():
    sql, params = routes.build_parametrized_query("SELECT 'a%' WHERE x = {p}", {"p": "v"})
    assert sql == "SELECT 'a%' WHERE x = %(p)s" and params == {"p": "v"}
    assert routes.build_parametrized_query("SELECT 1", {}) == ("SELECT 1", None)

objective: SEC-P1: cerrar POST /api/servers/{server_id}/universal-query-test. (1) Fail-closed: 401 sin sesion / 403 sin rol ADMIN-SUPERADMIN resuelto desde SQL (core.security.get_current_user carga el usuario de Usuario_Catalogo), antes de leer Servidores_Conexiones o ejecutar SQL. (2) sql_libre se ejecuta contra la base central multiempresa: solo SUPERADMIN; conexion/diagnostico/api_rest para ADMIN limitados a servidores de sus empresas (get_user_empresas_permitidas + get_servers_for_empresas). (3) Elimina substitute_parameters (interpolacion de texto) y usa parametros enlazados pymssql %(key)s; claves validadas por regex y valores solo escalares. (4) La transaccion del probador siempre hace rollback. Contrato de respuesta conservado. Un solo archivo funcional + tests unitarios sin BD. Sin cambios en RBAC, credenciales, SQL Server ni produccion. Hallazgos P3 fuera de alcance.
